before:
-- Order line-item detail: one row per order line, enriched for order analytics.
-- Materialized as ORDER_ENTRY_DB.analytics.order_details and registered in DataHub,
-- where its `order_total` column is the source of the `order_total_avg` feature in the
-- `order_features` table (consumed by ltv_model_v1).
select
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    order_total,                 -- source of order_features.order_total_avg
    order_status,
    order_date
from raw_order_details
